basis: Defective erythrocyte methemoglobin reduction defines a blood disorder; generalized metabolic or neurologic disease is not established.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: a blood-cell reductase deficiency does not establish a systemic metabolic disorder.

basis: Broad hematolymphoid-system disorder encompassing nodal and splenic disease; no shared infectious, autoimmune or immunodeficiency mechanism is established.

decisions.haematologic: primary: hematolymphoid tissue is the closest applicable axis for this broad nodal, splenic and lymphatic-system category.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: lymphatic anatomy alone does not establish infection, immunodeficiency, autoimmunity or lymphoma across the umbrella.

basis: Defining immunodeficiency, skin disease and lung lesions; retained teeth 47/63 and esophageal infiltration 11/17 support GI damage. Skeletal disease and otitis (30-79%) omitted at cap.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: recurrent pneumonia (68/72) and pulmonary cysts (47/63) are defining pulmonary manifestations.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: retained primary teeth affect 47/63 and esophageal eosinophilic infiltration 11/17, supporting common direct oral/esophageal involvement.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: characteristic eczema (80-99%) and recurrent cutaneous abscesses (58/64) are defining manifestations.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none at cap: fractures, osteoporosis and scoliosis occur in 30-79%; the retained axes have stronger frequency evidence.

basis: IgG4-mediated pancreatitis with direct inflammatory bile-duct involvement in roughly 50-70%; renal involvement is generally below 30%. Compression-only jaundice does not establish hepatic damage.

decisions.hepatic: involved: direct IgG4-related bile-duct inflammation occurs in roughly 50-70% as an extrapancreatic manifestation of the same systemic process.

basis: Muscular dystrophy and joint contractures define disease; esotropia is annotated in 30-79%. Respiratory failure reflects diaphragmatic weakness rather than direct pulmonary disease.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory failure occurs in 30-79%, but the demonstrated lesion is respiratory skeletal-muscle weakness, without intrinsic lung or airway damage.

basis: Cold-precipitating plasma fibrinogen disorder; acrocyanosis alone does not establish lasting vascular injury. Renal findings are transient or lack frequency evidence.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: thrombotic vascular injury is not established as defining or present in at least 30% of this familial form; acrocyanosis alone is insufficient.

basis: Usually originates in deep limb soft tissue; supplied HPO subcutaneous nodules (80-99%) support subcutis occupation. GI symptoms occur in only 5-29% without established tissue damage.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: HPO documents subcutaneous nodules in 80-99%; usual origin is deep limb soft tissue, supporting secondary subcutis involvement rather than primary skin origin.

basis: Forebrain malformation with eye abnormalities (80-99%), hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction (~70% in classic HPE), and median cleft upper lip (30-79%). Aspiration pneumonia is separate.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: median cleft upper lip is a direct structural oral malformation annotated in 30-79%; feeding symptoms alone would not establish GI damage.

basis: Vitamin C deficiency causes skin fragility/hemorrhage and gingival breakdown, each commonly exceeding 30%. Anemia is often secondary to bleeding or accompanying nutrient deficiencies.

decisions.haematologic: none: reported anemia (~30-80%) commonly reflects blood loss or accompanying iron/folate deficiency; common direct blood-cell or marrow injury is not established.

basis: Congenital skeletal myopathy with fractures; respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness. Obstructive sleep apnea (3/3) is separately diagnosed and does not prove intrinsic airway injury.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory muscle weakness belongs to musculoskeletal disease; separately diagnosed obstructive sleep apnea in 3/3 does not establish direct pulmonary damage.
